name: When is the best time for finish carpentry installation during a renovation?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time for finish carpentry installation during a renovation?

acceptedAnswer.text: Finish carpentry is typically performed near the end of a renovation project, after major structural work, drywall installation, and painting are complete. This timing protects the delicate finished materials from damage by other trades and ensures a clean, dust-free environment for installation. Flooring is often installed before or during finish carpentry, depending on the type and specific project requirements. Coordinating with other trades is crucial for a smooth workflow.
acceptedAnswer.description: Finish carpentry is best scheduled towards the end of a renovation, after major structural work, drywall, and painting are done, to protect materials.
